name: Franchise Architect: Football
currentFocus: Session 91 made the league hold its shape, where S90 made it hold its level. Opened on the one thing S90 refused to rank — an elite-tail figure disclosed as confounded by free-agent-pool growth — and tested the confound first, as the handoff demanded. It inverted: holding the denominator structurally fixed at the ~2,180 roster slots S89 pinned, 90+ players go 5 -> 88 across 12 seasons (0.32% -> 4.03%), only 1 of 89 elite players is unrostered, and the pool was diluting the figure rather than inflating it. That exposed the larger defect: the progression-parity gate filtered on status != retired, blending the rostered league with an unbounded pool whose size is a free parameter. Rostered mean overall rises +0.089/season while the blended mean falls -0.072/season — and the blended number is exactly the -0.073 S90 certified as steady state. Underneath sat the mechanism: developmentDelta used potential only as a constant drift coefficient, so development was a random walk players took past their own potential, with selection truncating only its bottom. New src/domain/potentialReversion.js adds the missing reversion, zero-centred by construction and measured over exactly the population it is applied to. Measured after on two seeds: 90+ density 4.03% -> 2.07%, players above their own potential 37.4% -> 21.2%, veterans 26.3% -> 5.7%, and the elite count plateaus from season 8 where pre-fix it was still climbing at season 12. A distributional gate now reads dispersion drift and elite density together, because they demonstrably fail apart. A fifth defect arrived as a red: the offseason's only compliance pass ran before the draft added a full rookie class, so camp-cuts performed no cuts and the league came to rest in a state the authority had never examined; legality is now the offseason's final act. Elite density measures 2.07% over 12 seasons pre-camp-cuts-fix and 2.6% over the 10-season decade regression after it, against a 1.6%/2.4% ceiling declared judgement-not-measured, so the gate reads out-of-range; two routes to green (raising the reversion rate, moving the ceiling) were both refused and the residual is disclosed rather than resolved. Public launch remains HOLD and launchReady stays false.
nextMilestone: Build a real NFL elite-density baseline into src/data and re-source both ends of the S91 distributional gate from it. The 1.6% ceiling is declared judgement-not-measured and the post-fix league settles at 2.07%, so the receipt honestly reports watch. Do NOT close that by tuning POTENTIAL_REVERSION_PROFILE.rate, and do not assume the ceiling is the wrong end — a fresh league opens at 0.32% (five 90+ players across 32 clubs), so if the generator is wrong then both ends of the measurement are.
blockers: Pre-existing red outside the canonical receipt — test/realism-career-regression.test.js fails in the excluded long shard on 0.228 annual overall drift vs a 0.15 ceiling; verified to reproduce on pristine HEAD 8ddc310, queued as S90 calibration.

lastVerification: S91 canonical Node receipt 1,181/1,181 across all six shards, direct exit 0 (not a wrapper status). Two reds surfaced during the session and both were root-fixed: camp-cuts performed no cuts so the league came to rest over the cap (IND -3.3M at 2028, seed 20260817, 68 players and never trapped), and the numeric-integrity scan exhausted its node budget on a decade. The progression receipt's distributional verdict is honestly out-of-range on an elite-density ceiling declared judgement-not-measured; two routes to green were available and both refused. Public launch remains no-go.
freeTierAuditNote: Session 75 refresh: browser-first game plus a bounded, cached community aggregate on the existing shared self-hosted server. No language model, email, paid analytics vendor, or per-user API spend; marginal cost remains zero within current fixed infrastructure capacity.
